preconditions.expression: isinstance(root, TreeNode) or root is None
preconditions.description: The root is either a TreeNode or None.

postconditions.description: The return value is an integer.
The return value is within the range of -10^6 to 10^6.

postconditions.expression: root is None or return_value == max_leaf_to_root_sum(root)
postconditions.description: The return value is the maximum sum of a path from a leaf to the root.
